import os
from unittest.mock import patch
from flask.app import Flask

def test_auto_find_instance_path_prefix_none():
    with patch('flask.app.find_package') as mock_find:
        mock_find.return_value = (None, '/fake/package')
        app = Flask(__name__)
        result = app.auto_find_instance_path()
        expected = os.path.join('/fake/package', 'instance')
        assert result == expected

def test_auto_find_instance_path_prefix_not_none():
    with patch('flask.app.find_package') as mock_find:
        mock_find.return_value = ('/fake/prefix', '/fake/package')
        app = Flask(__name__)
        app.name = 'myapp'
        result = app.auto_find_instance_path()
        expected = os.path.join('/fake/prefix', 'var', 'myapp-instance')
        assert result == expected

# Ensure unreachable return None is not executed for any case
def test_auto_find_instance_path_never_returns_none():
    with patch('flask.app.find_package') as mock_find:
        # both branches covered
        for ret in [(None, '/pkg'), ('/pref', '/pkg')]:
            mock_find.return_value = ret
            app = Flask(__name__)
            app.name = 'test'
            assert app.auto_find_instance_path() is not None

import pytest
from flask.config import Config

def make_config(**kwargs):
    c = Config(None, None)
    c.update(kwargs)
    return c

@pytest.mark.parametrize("namespace,lowercase,trim_namespace,input_dict,expected", [
    # basic case
    ("IMAGE_STORE_", True, True,
     {"IMAGE_STORE_TYPE": "fs", "IMAGE_STORE_PATH": "/var/app/images", "IMAGE_STORE_BASE_URL": "http://img.website.com"},
     {"type": "fs", "path": "/var/app/images", "base_url": "http://img.website.com"}),
    # lowercase=False
    ("IMAGE_STORE_", False, True,
     {"IMAGE_STORE_TYPE": "fs", "IMAGE_STORE_PATH": "/var/app/images"},
     {"TYPE": "fs", "PATH": "/var/app/images"}),
    # trim_namespace=False, lowercase=True
    ("IMAGE_STORE_", True, False,
     {"IMAGE_STORE_TYPE": "fs"},
     {"image_store_type": "fs"}),
    # both false
    ("IMAGE_STORE_", False, False,
     {"IMAGE_STORE_TYPE": "fs"},
     {"IMAGE_STORE_TYPE": "fs"}),
    # namespace longer than key? shouldn't happen because startswith ensures len>=len(namespace)
    ("PREFIX_", True, True,
     {"PREFIX_A": 1, "PREFIX_AB": 2},
     {"a": 1, "ab": 2}),
    # mixed case keys with lowercase True
    ("PREFIX_", True, True,
     {"PREFIX_aBc": 5, "PREFIX_XYz": 6},
     {"abc": 5, "xyz": 6}),
    # no matches
    ("PREFIX_", True, True,
     {"OTHER": 1, "another": 2},
     {}),
    # empty config
    ("PREFIX_", True, True,
     {},
     {}),
    # namespace empty string matches all keys
    ("", True, True,
     {"A": 1, "b": 2},
     {"a": 1, "b": 2}),
    # namespace empty, trim false, lowercase false
    ("", False, False,
     {"A": 1, "b": 2},
     {"A": 1, "b": 2}),
])
def test_get_namespace(namespace, lowercase, trim_namespace, input_dict, expected):
    cfg = make_config(**input_dict)
    result = cfg.get_namespace(namespace, lowercase=lowercase, trim_namespace=trim_namespace)
    assert result == expected

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-q"])
